title: DayPlay results
description: Verified records and/or composed outing itineraries written to the run's default dataset — one item per record (plan mode writes a single itinerary item with stops and walk legs; events/places modes write one item per record; refusals/empty results write a single status item).

results.title: Results
results.description: All records written to the default dataset: composed itineraries (plan mode), verified event/place records (events/places modes), or status items (out_of_market / zero_results / input_error).
